d:
Traffic Challan Law : bihar ke vahan chalkon ke lie bari rahat ki khabar samne aaee hai. ab traiphik chalan bharne ke lie lanbi prakriya aur jhanjhat se jald chhutkara mil sakta hai. vahan chalak Google Pay aur PhonePe jaise UPI aip ke jarie ghar baithe apna traiphik chalan bhar sakenge.
Is naee suvidha se chalan bhugtan ki prakriya aasan aur suvidhajnak hone ki ummid hai. aakhir kab se shuru hogi yah suvidha aur vahan chalkon ko kaise milega iska phayda? janie puri khabar is riport men.
